scenes.text: Read digits from left to right in groups of three: millions, thousands and ones. A thousand millions is one billion.

Which words name 417,840,000? The answer is four hundred and seventeen million eight hundred and forty thousand. Read millions, then thousands, then units: four hundred and seventeen million eight hundred and forty thousand.
A records office at a science exhibition writes “six hundred and six million sixty-four thousand”. Select the matching numeral. Pause to choose and explain.

A records office at a science exhibition writes “six hundred and six million sixty-four thousand”. Select the matching numeral. The answer is 606,064,000. The millions group and thousands group give 606,064,000.
